name: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids/Appliances
full_name: Scheme of Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids/Appliances (ADIP SCHEME)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_value_inr: Up to Rs. 6,000 for aids/appliances; Up to Rs. 8,000 for visually, mentally, speech & hearing or multiple disabled during their study period after IX standard; Rs. 500 for hearing & speech impaired for medical/surgical correction & intervention; Rs. 1,000 for visually disabled for medical/surgical correction & intervention; Rs. 3,000 for Orthopaedically disabled for medical/surgical correction & intervention

name: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids/Appliances
full_name: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids/Appliances (ADIP)
ministry: MINISTRY OF SOCIAL JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT
benefit_value_inr: Aids / appliance which do not cost more than Rs. 10,000/- are covered under the Scheme for single disability. In the case of SwDs, students beyond Intellectual Disability (ID) class, the limit would be raised the Rs. 12,000/-. In the case of multiple disabilities, the limit will apply to individual items separately in case more than one aid / appliance is required.

name: Central Sector Plan Scheme of Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities
full_name: Central Sector Plan Scheme of Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities
ministry: MINISTRY OF SOCIAL JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT
benefit_value_inr: Monthly stipend of Rs.2500/- (Rupees Two Thousand and Five Hundred only) per student will be paid for local students for attending the coaching class. Similarly, Rs.5000/- (Rupees Five Thousand only) per student will be paid p.m for outstation students. Special Allowance of Rs.2,000/- (Rupees Two Thousand only) per student p.m will be paid to students towards reader allowance, escort allowance, helper allowance etc.
application_process: Apply through the Empanelled Coaching Institutes of their choice through off-line method

name: Revised Incentive Scheme for providing employment to Persons with Disabilities
full_name: Revised Incentive Scheme for providing employment to Persons with Disabilities (PwDS) in the private sector
ministry: MINISTRY OF SOCIAL JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT
benefit_value_inr: The Government shall pay the employers contribution to EPFO & ESIC for 10 yrs. One-third of the gratuity amount due and admissible to PwD employees which is required to be paid by the employers under the applicable provisions of the Gratuity Act, shall be borne by the DEPwD. In case a private employer engages PwDs as apprentices in a particular trade and employ them on completion of the apprenticeship period, the stipend during the apprenticeship period payable to the PwD shall be borne by the DEPwD.
application_process: The employers need not deposit the EPF/ESI contribution in respect of their PwD employees. The employers just need to intimate the EPFO/ESIC regarding appointments made by them and furnish employee's contribution to EPFO/ESIC.
